description: List all public work kinds as name/slug pairs. Use the kind slug as tag when browsing works. Optional browse filters also return live facets for collections, dynasties and types; the static list stays complete.

category.description: Dynasty name from list_dynasties, for example 唐. Not a group name.

collection.description: Collection ID string from list_collections, for example "1".

tag.description: Work kind slug from list_types: shi (诗), ci (词), qu (曲), wen (文).

name: list_types
